counts.name: limitations
counts.value: ["Copy metrics are routing-conditioned subpopulations, not unbiased target estimates.", "Insertion edit coverage can quarantine PE-bearing fragments without an equivalent WT quarantine; confident cohorts may be PE-depleted. No correction is applied.", "Target all-read metrics are the primary population view when eligible.", "Prepared exact classification requires inward-facing amplicon-end reads with a unique sequence-consistent overlap of at least 10 nt and complete reconstruction; uniquely supported exact reference products may exclude terminal read-through (0.7.1); internal fragments, gaps and disagreements are excluded.", "Backend preprocessing/alignment and product assessability impose additional metric-specific filters; no single stage defines every denominator.", "Exact and native PE fractions have different numerators and denominators; either may be higher. Direction alone does not establish editing quality.", "Backend unaligned causes remain unknown unless authoritative evidence establishes them. Biological origins are not inferred.", "Closed, correctly specified target panels and M3.1.2 geometry/placement qualification remain required; unseen panels are not biologically certified.", "Verification assumes immutable trusted archives; coordinated rewriting of all trusted artifacts and large-scale memory performance are not qualified."]
